query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'Blocked or slow drains cleared fast. We use high-pressure power flushing and mechanical snaking to restore full flow in residential and commercial drain lines across London Ontario.',
  longDesc = 'A slow drain is easy to ignore until it backs up completely. By the time water is standing in your sink or backing up into your basement floor drain, the blockage has usually been building for a while.\n\nWe clear blocked drains using two main methods. For most residential blockages, mechanical snaking with a motorized auger breaks through grease, hair, and soft obstructions quickly and without chemicals. For more stubborn blockages, root intrusion, or commercial lines that need a thorough cleaning, we use high-pressure power flushing. A water jet at up to 4,000 PSI scours the inside of the pipe, cutting through grease buildup and flushing debris downstream. The combination of mechanical clearing and high-pressure flushing is the most effective way to restore a drain line to full capacity.\n\nFor commercial properties, restaurants, and multi-unit buildings, regular drain maintenance prevents the kind of emergency backups that shut down operations. We work with property managers and business owners to set up maintenance schedules that keep drain lines clear year-round.\n\nEvery drain cleaning call includes a free camera inspection so you can see the condition of the pipe after clearing. If there is root intrusion or structural damage that will cause the line to block again, we will show you on camera and explain your options for a permanent fix.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"High-Pressure Power Flushing","desc":"Up to 4,000 PSI water jetting scours grease, scale, and debris from the inside of the pipe, restoring full flow capacity in residential and commercial lines."},{"title":"Mechanical Snaking","desc":"Motorized augers clear most residential blockages quickly without chemicals, cutting through grease, hair, and soft obstructions."},{"title":"Free Camera Inspection Included","desc":"After clearing the line, we run the camera through to show you the condition of the pipe and confirm the blockage is fully cleared."},{"title":"Commercial Maintenance Programs","desc":"We work with property managers and business owners to schedule regular drain maintenance, preventing emergency backups before they happen."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Drain Cleaning and Power Flushing London ON | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Drain cleaning and high-pressure power flushing in London Ontario. Residential and commercial. Free camera inspection included. 24/7 emergency. Call 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'drain-cleaning';
